dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250922-GIN-02](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250922-GIN-02) A flood occurred on Sep 22 2025 in Guinea. It affected an estimated 187078 people and 44602 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
